notes.title: Kana Ka-Boom v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Kana Ka-Boom - v1.1.0[/h1]

[h3]Japanese Input Now Supported[/h3]

For those of you with Japanese keyboards (or keyboard covers) that are working on memorizing those keyboard layouts for typing.

I will add some detailed documentation on Steam for setting up Japanese IME on both Windows and OSX, but here are the basics for those of you that are already setup:

[b]For OSX[/b]
[list]
[*]Everything just works
[*]Switch your input to Hiragana or Katakana and type away
[*]Control-J or F6 to switch to Hiragana
[*]Control-K or F7 to switch to Katakana
[*]For those of you with Mac laptops, I recommend this site for Japanese keyboard covers: https://kbcovers.com/product/japanese-keyboard-cover/
[/list]
[b]For Windows[/b]
[list]
[*]There are a few settings you'll need to tweak
[*]Make sure "Predictive Input" is off
[*]Make sure "Use Kana input for hardware keyboard" is on
[*]If you don't have a 109 key keyboard (with the Hankaku/Zenkaku key) then you'll want to set the "Ctrl + Space" key assignment to "IME-on/off"
[*]Ctrl + Caps lock to switch to Hiragana
[*]Alt + Caps lock to switch to Katakana
[/list]

[h3]Steam Achievements Now Work In OSX[/h3]

I use steamworks.js in order for my code to trigger Steam achievements and it wasn't working originally on the OSX side, but it appears they've fixed the issue in their latest build and now everything works! 




[i]- David @ BinaryCats[/i]

notes.title: Kana Ka-Boom - Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stroke order has been added to the drawing board. Whenever you go to either the Hiragana or Katakana charts and select a kana character (and also displayed during lesson intros) you will see the stroke order drawn over the kana character. Moving your mouse over the drawing board will stop the strokes from being drawn while you practice your own drawing skills... Simply move the mouse away and the strokes will begin drawing themselves again.
[/list]

[i]- David @ BinaryCats[/i]

notes.title: Kana Ka-Boom - Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Kana Ka-Boom - Patch 1.0.3[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Windows version of Kana Ka-Boom wasn't properly updating the database when switching between Windowed and Fullscreen modes.
[*]We had to remove the Steam Overlay from the Windows version of Kana Ka-Boom because it was failing to load properly in Windowed Mode and it was also causing an issue with closing the app during some play sessions.
[/list]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam Achievements are now reset when you choose Reset Database from Settings
[/list]

[b]More Info on Steam Integration:[/b]
We are using steamworks.js for our Steam integration (Steam Overlay & Achievements)... We discovered right away during final beta testing that steamworks.js isn't working at all on Mac builds, and thus we disabled those features for Mac. 

After going live, we additionally discovered that the Steam Overlay when called by steamworks.js is sometimes causing an issue with the app attempting to close and is held open by the Steam Overlay. Additionally, the Steam Overlay doesn't display properly when the game is running in Windowed Mode, so we ultimately decided the best situation moving forward was to disable Steam Overlay for Windows, but to leave Achievements active for Windows players.

We see that steamworks.js is aware of the Mac issue and the Steam Overlay issue on their Issues tracker. We will keep monitoring their progress on resolution and also investigate what other libraries are available out there in case we decide we need to migrate to another solution to get these features working.

[i]- David @ BinaryCats[/i]

notes.title: Kana Ka-Boom has launched!
notes.notes:
We've launched! I'm incredibly excited to have Kana Ka-Boom up and available on Steam!

I'm still learning the in's and out's of Steam, but wanted to get an announcement up on our community page.

This game was designed for those of you that are just starting to learn the Japanese language and for those that want an entertaining way to practice your Katakana and Hiragana. So far, I've only been able to find drag n' drop kana games and flash card games for entry level learning of kana characters which prompted the creation of Kana Ka-Boom.

For those of you on the fence about purchasing the game, you can play the online demo at
https://kanakaboom.binarycats.com/demo
to try out all of the Katakana section and get a feel for how the game works.

If you do purchase, I'd like you to know that your money will be going right back into making Kana Ka-Boom a better product. In the immediate, I have plans to bring stroke order and the ability for Free Play to remember the settings of your last session. In the future, I'd like to add basic Kanji and words to Kana Ka-Boom and build it up to being a tool that can get you on your way to the JLPT N5 exam.

I love feedback! So if you have any thoughts, criticisms, or ideas on how I can make Kana Ka-Boom a better product, please feel free to leave them here for me!

Again, thank you for your interest in this game!
~ David @ BinaryCats
